english.title: Sink well or borehole fail allow access to inspect or examine or take specimen or copies
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person sinking a well or borehole intended to reach a depth of more than fifty feet below the surface, failed to allow **(..SPECIFY AUTHORISED PERSON..), a person authorised by the United Kingdom Research and Innovation for the purpose, on production of a duly authorised document showing

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

authority, at a reasonable time to exercise a right to have free access to the well or borehole and inspect it and the material extracted from it, to take a specimen of material and of water abstracted from it and to inspect and take copies of or extracts from the journal required to be kept under section 198 of the Water Resources Act 1991
english.legislation: Contrary to section 198(2)(c) and (8) of the Water Resources Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale and, where the offence continues after conviction, to a further fine of £20 for every day during which it so continues

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months
